Direct Known Subclasses:
TreeObject
public class GraphObject extends GroupObject
Graph-theory container; coordinates are explicitly supplied for reproducible layouts.

Provides a normal transformed group for nodes and edges. Layout is explicit; Scene validation resolves endpoint IDs and checks they share the edge parent.
